Immersive Mode

Distant cannon fire, musketry, and quiet -- a soundscape generated live in your browser, driven by how many units are actually engaged at each moment.

All audio here is synthesized in real time with the Web Audio API (no recorded sound files) so its intensity is directly tied to the real unit density at each tick -- more units in contact means more and louder cannon/musket cues.
